VENDOR SECURITY QUESTIONNAIRE

Requesting organisation: Thornbury Federal Credit Union
Vendor: Larkspur Data Systems, Inc.
Service under review: hosted loan origination platform
Completed by: Priyanka Deshmukh, VP Information Security, Larkspur Data Systems, Inc.
Date completed: April 22, 2026

SECTION A — GOVERNANCE

A1. Do you maintain a written information security policy approved by executive management?
Yes. Our information security policy was last approved by the Board of Directors on January 14, 2026 and is reviewed annually.

A2. Do you hold a current SOC 2 Type II report or ISO/IEC 27001 certificate?
Yes. A SOC 2 Type II report covering security, availability, and confidentiality for the period July 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025 was issued on February 20, 2026 by Marchetti & Foss LLP. It is available under NDA.

A3. Who is accountable for information security at your organisation?
The VP Information Security reports to the Chief Technology Officer and presents to the Board's Risk Committee quarterly.

SECTION B — ACCESS CONTROL

B1. Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all administrative access?
Yes, for all administrative and remote access, using hardware security keys or a TOTP authenticator. SMS is not accepted.

B2. How often is access reviewed?
Access is reviewed quarterly by the system owner. Terminated personnel lose access within 4 hours of the termination ticket.

B3. Do you use shared or generic accounts?
No. Break-glass accounts exist for two systems; each use is logged, alerts the security team, and requires a written justification within one business day.

SECTION C — DATA PROTECTION

C1. Is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
Yes. AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Keys are managed in a hardware security module and rotated annually.

C2. Where is customer data stored?
In the United States only, in two regions of a major cloud provider. No customer data is stored or accessed outside the United States.

C3. Do you use subprocessors with access to customer data?
Yes, three. A current list is maintained at larkspurdata.com/subprocessors and we give 30 days notice before adding one.

SECTION D — INCIDENT RESPONSE

D1. Do you maintain a documented incident response plan?
Yes, tested by tabletop exercise at least annually. The last exercise was held on October 8, 2025.

D2. What is your customer notification commitment following a security incident?
We notify affected customers without undue delay and in any event within 48 hours of confirming an incident affecting their data.

D3. Have you experienced a reportable security incident in the last 24 months?
No.

SECTION E — RESILIENCE

E1. What are your recovery time and recovery point objectives?
RTO of 4 hours and RPO of 15 minutes for the production platform.

E2. When did you last test your disaster recovery plan?
A full failover test was performed on November 12, 2025 and completed within the stated RTO.

ATTESTATION

The undersigned confirms that the answers above are accurate as of the date completed and undertakes to notify Thornbury Federal Credit Union of any material change within 30 days.

/s/ Priyanka Deshmukh
Priyanka Deshmukh, VP Information Security
Larkspur Data Systems, Inc.
